description: State Ministry of Soler Wind and Hydro Power Construction Projects Development - Proposals to Generate and Supply of Electrical Energy from Renewable Energy Resources on Build an Operate Basis (Boo)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns regulatory and procedural matters related to energy project development. It amends a previous gazette notification regarding the submission process and deadline for proposals to generate electrical energy from renewable resources. The content focuses on legal/administrative procedures (extending a deadline, specifying submission methods) under a regulatory framework for energy development, rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
